name: hickory-dns
description: Internal DNS server for WireGuard mesh (per-service mesh zone)

dns._mesh_zone_doc: #1123 (owner decision, no transition): the zone mesh.diegonmarcos.com is the fleet-only mesh namespace (<container>.mesh.diegonmarcos.com), served ONLY by this resolver; the public zone carries no record under mesh (sentinel TXT). The public .app TLD zone is gone. The wildcard answers the Caddy hub as in every other zone.
dns._records_doc: Per-zone specific A records emitted BEFORE the wildcard so they win over the catch-all `* IN A <caddy_wg_ip>`. NOTE: do NOT override `mail.diegonmarcos.com` / `jmap.diegonmarcos.com` / `imap.diegonmarcos.com` here — those hostnames must still resolve to the public Caddy edge (oci-analytics) for HTTPS probes; the wildcard already covers that. The `mesh.diegonmarcos.com` zone is purely internal so its records can point straight at the backend VMs.
dns._caddy_wg_ipv6_doc: wg0 mesh ULA of the Caddy/DNS host (gcp-proxy). Mirrors .services.caddy.ip in src/build-hickory-dns.json. Set ⇒ every zone gains apex + wildcard AAAA so mesh clients prefer IPv6 (Happy Eyeballs) and fall back to IPv4; remove the field to go back to v4-only zones.
dns._records_cloud_prefix_doc: Private scheme cloud.<name>.mesh.diegonmarcos.com (cloud-infra a0_docs/eng-specs/url-scheme.md). The `*` wildcard already answers every cloud.<name>.mesh.diegonmarcos.com with the Caddy hub; only the direct-dial names above (mail backends, git-proxy-api mesh auth) need their own cloud.* rows, mirroring their legacy <name> rows.
dns._records_mesh_direct_doc: Mesh transport (#1104 architect ruling): the canonical mesh address of a container is http://<name>.mesh.diegonmarcos.com:<port>, dialled directly on its VM's WireGuard address (plain HTTP inside WG, no hub hop). A container gets an owned row here (A only, its VM wg0 IP) and binds its declared port on wg0 only. c3-infra-api: 10.0.0.6:8081 (HOST=10.0.0.6, network_mode host). Guard: _shared/test-fleet-addressing.mjs rule mesh_direct.
dns._records_git_proxy_api_doc: #849 git-proxy-api binds only oci-analytics wg0 10.0.0.4:8123 (no hub route, and #837 mesh auth needs a direct dial without X-Forwarded-*). A only, no AAAA: the service has no v6 bind, and an owned name stops the wildcard AAAA from pointing it back at the hub.
